title.zh: 将Guinobatan农村中学改设为农校，名称为Roxas纪念农业学校，并将阿尔拜省Guinobatan的Mauraro原属日本侨民、现属菲律宾共和国的全部财产交其使用与维护的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Guinobatan Rural High School into an Agricultural School to be Known as the Roxas Memorial Agricultural School, and Placing at its Disposal All the Properties, Including Their Income, in Mauraro, Guinobatan, Albay, Which Formerly Belonged to Japanese Subjects and Now Belong to the Republic of the Philippines, for the Use, Maintenance, Operation and Improvement of Said Agricultural School

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_338_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Guinobatan Rural High School at Guinobatan, Albay, is hereby converted into an agricultural school to be known as the Roxas Memorial Agricultural School.

All members of the teaching staff and personnel, and all appropriations, furniture, equipment and other properties of the Guinobatan Rural High School existing at the time of approval of this Act shall thereafter belong to the Roxas Memorial Agricultural School.

All lands, buildings and other properties in Mauraro, Guinobatan, Albay, which formerly belonged to Japanese subjects and now belong to the Republic of the Philippines shall, altogether with their income, be transferred to and placed at the disposal of the Roxas Memorial Agricultural School for the use, maintenance, operation and improvement of said Agricultural School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: July 24, 1948.
